# Vendored third-party code

These files were recovered from the v16.11 build output, where they had been bundled from npm packages.
They are kept as-is (only re-formatted) until they can be swapped back for the npm packages.

| File | Package | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `clsx.js` | clsx | MIT |
| `class-variance-authority.js` | class-variance-authority 0.7.1 | Apache-2.0 |
| `tailwind-merge.js` | tailwind-merge 3.6.0 | MIT |
| `zod.js` | zod 3.25.x | MIT |

`../ui/primitives.js` holds the small dialog, select, tabs and collapsible primitives the UI kit is built on.
Its origin (a radix-style shim, possibly from `@shadcn/react`) could not be confirmed from the build output.
